tangram_module_a_h138.description: Tangram module A H. 138 - quarter-round, 1 rh/lh door, 3 shelves
tangram_module_a_h138.source_ref: printed p.58 (drawing) and p.61 (code, contents) / PDF 60, 63
tangram_module_a_h138.not_buildable_reason: CURVED. The book prints the footprint - two edge dimensions on the printed p.58 drawing - and the curve itself not at all: no radius, no arc, no profile. A box drawn at the footprint would be a wrong shape that looks settled (domain rule 1). The geometry comes from Cesar - a factory SKP or Elda - and until it does the code is held for LOOKUP and reconciliation, not for building.
tangram_module_a_h138.notes: Footprint 35 x 35 (printed p.58, the same drawing as module A). 3 glass shelves are an option priced separately.
tangram_module_a_h138.wall_hung_note: SWEPT 2026-09-26 on the renders of printed p.58-61: no 'Hung version' glyph beside any Tangram position. A curved unit stands on its own curved plinth article (ZOCCT0x), so false is also the only reading that fits the page.
